patch_resolves_note: The best-effort `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` rebuild in the vulnerable image still reproduced the crash, so fixed-side evidence uses the authoritative `n132/arvo:42473836-fix` image. There the same `BNDLDXrm` witness path reaches `printMemReference()` with `MI->op1_size` already set to 16, skips `MI->op1_size = MI->x86opsize`, and the later sink reads an initialized byte.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `printMemReference()` can fall back to `MI->op1_size = MI->x86opsize`, the earlier BND register-width path must already have established a nonzero `MI->op1_size` for this instruction.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the vulnerable `BNDLDXrm` witness path, the missing BND entries in `regsize_map_32` leave `MI->op1_size` at 0 when `printMemReference()` evaluates `if (MI->op1_size == 0)`. In the authoritative fixed image, the same path reaches this guard with `MI->op1_size = 16`, so the fallback copy is no longer needed.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace violates the required predicate at `copy_guard` (`op1_size = 0`, `zero_literal = 0`) while the protected event executes. In the authoritative fixed-image run, `copy_guard` still executes but records `op1_size = 16`, so the required assertion is genuine without perturbation.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, the left operand of `if (MI->op1_size == 0 && reg)` reads the one-byte `MI->op1_size` field after the fallback path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_sink.op1_size_initialized_prefix_len = 0` and `op1_size_sink.op1_size_read_bytes = 1` immediately before the sink read.

nodes.description: Immediately after `printMemReference()` executes `MI->op1_size = MI->x86opsize`, the destination byte `MI->op1_size` is still uninitialized on the vulnerable witness path.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_copy.op1_size_initialized_prefix_len = 0` and `op1_size_copy.op1_size_store_bytes = 1` immediately after the fallback copy.

edges.relation: The same `MI->op1_size` field examined by the fallback guard is the destination field overwritten one statement later by `MI->op1_size = MI->x86opsize`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `copy_guard.op1_size_field_addr == op1_size_copy.op1_size_field_addr == 0x7ffc49d7041e`.

edges.relation: The same `MI->op1_size` byte written by the fallback copy in `printMemReference()` is the byte later consumed at the `X86_Intel_printInst()` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `op1_size_copy.op1_size_field_addr == op1_size_sink.op1_size_field_addr == 0x7ffc49d7041e`.
